name: High Value Transaction Alert
description: Flag transactions with an amount greater than a specified threshold.
limitations: amount_usd uses static FX estimates, so a large native COP amount can sit well below this USD threshold.

name: Multiple Small Transactions in Short Period
description: Identify users with a high frequency of small transactions within a short time frame.
limitations: The 1h window count is not filtered by amount, so a burst of large transactions also satisfies clause 2.

name: Unusual Transaction Type for User
description: Flag transactions where the type is unusual for a given user's historical patterns.
limitations: Share is computed over the sender's full history, including the current row, so the first time a type appears it is already counted in the share.

name: Transaction to High-Risk Merchant
description: Alert on transactions made to merchants identified as high-risk.
limitations: merchant_risk_tier is not in the dataset, and merchant-risk.json ships empty, so this rule cannot evaluate.

name: Cross-Border Transaction Anomaly
description: Flag transactions where the merchant country is different from the user's typical transaction countries and the amount is significant.
limitations: Typical country is the sender's modal merchant_country over full history, so a sender who mostly shops abroad will not be flagged for those countries.

name: Transaction Outside Normal Hours
description: Identify transactions occurring outside typical business hours for the user's timezone.
limitations: The overnight window wraps midnight, so the clauses are OR (hour >= 22 OR hour <= 6), not AND.

name: Large Cash Withdrawal
description: Flag large cash withdrawals from ATMs.
limitations: The type domain has no ATM or withdrawal category, so clause 1 can never pass on this dataset.
